data.title: The Sun Test
data.description: Help us move the sun across the sky and test what gets warm on the island.

challenges.instruction: The dark stone and the pale stone sit in the same tank all day. Only the colour is different. Which one will get warmer? Tap it to make your guess, then move the sun across the sky.

right.name: the stone in the shade hut

challenges.difference: Only the place is different: one is in the sun, one is in the shade hut.
challenges.instruction: The stone in the sun and the stone in the shade hut sit in the same tank all day. Only the place is different: one is in the sun, one is in the shade hut. Which one will get warmer? Tap it to make your guess, then move the sun across the sky.

challenges.difference: Only what is in the cup is different.
challenges.instruction: The cup of sand and the cup of water sit in the same tank all day. Only what is in the cup is different. Which one will get warmer? Tap it to make your guess, then move the sun across the sky.
